text: The magnetic part of the Lorentz force, qv×B, does no work on a charged particle because it is always perpendicular to the velocity.
explanation: Since qv×B is perpendicular to v, the force has no component along the motion, so it does no work and cannot change the particle's kinetic energy — it only bends the trajectory. This is why a uniform B produces circular motion at constant speed with cyclotron frequency ω_c = qB/m.
